description: Search Fiverr gigs and categories, fetch gig details, read seller profiles, or list entries from Fiverr's public sitemaps.

category.description: Only keep results in this Fiverr category. Applies to category directory entries, and to gig details and enriched search results when the page reports that category slug. Leave empty for all categories.
category.title: Top-level category

categoryLevel.description: Only keep category entries at this level (mode=sitemapDirectory, sitemapType=categories).
categoryLevel.title: Category level filter

deliveryTime.description: Keep only gigs with this delivery speed (mode=search).
deliveryTime.title: Delivery time

facets.description: Optional category-specific filters for search, as `key:value` strings, e.g. `style:flat_minimalist` or `file_format:svg`. Unknown values are skipped with a warning.
facets.title: Category filters

gigUrls.description: Full Fiverr gig URLs to fetch, e.g. `https://www.fiverr.com/username/gig-slug` (mode=gigDetails).
gigUrls.title: Gig URLs

hourlyOnly.description: Keep only gigs that offer an hourly rate (mode=search).
hourlyOnly.title: Hourly gigs only

ideaType.description: Only keep Logo Maker entries of this type (mode=sitemapDirectory, sitemapType=logomakerIdeas).
ideaType.title: Logo Maker idea type

includeFaq.description: Include the gig's public FAQ list when present.
includeFaq.title: Include FAQ

includeGigDetails.description: Fetch each search result's gig page for packages, reviews, FAQ and the full seller card (mode=search). Also preserves the legacy discoverAndFetchDetails path.
includeGigDetails.title: Include gig details

includeMarketSummary.description: Emit one summary row per search query with result count, price range, seller-level mix and top seller countries.
includeMarketSummary.title: Include market summary

includePackages.description: Include package pricing, delivery, revisions, features and paid extras on gig details.
includePackages.title: Include package breakdown

includeSellerGigs.description: Include the seller's gig list on seller profile records.
includeSellerGigs.title: Include seller gigs

includeSellerReviews.description: Include the seller's latest reviews and rating breakdown on seller profile records.
includeSellerReviews.title: Include seller reviews

maxPagesPerQuery.description: Maximum result pages to read per search query or URL. Fiverr may stop earlier; this is an upper bound.
maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per search

maxPriceUsd.description: Only keep gigs whose lowest package price is at or below this amount (USD).
maxPriceUsd.title: Maximum starting price (USD)

maxShards.description: Number of sitemap shard files to scan for gigs (up to 7), sellers (up to 6) or tags (up to 2). Values above the available shard count are capped.
maxShards.title: Sitemap shards to scan

minPriceUsd.description: Only keep gigs whose lowest package price is at or above this amount (USD).
minPriceUsd.title: Minimum starting price (USD)

minRating.description: Only keep gigs or sellers with an average rating at or above this value (0-5).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviews.description: Only keep gigs or sellers with at least this many reviews.
minReviews.title: Minimum review count

mode.description: What to run. `search` searches Fiverr by keyword or browses search/category URLs. `gigDetails` fetches full details for gig URLs. `sellerProfiles` fetches seller profiles. `sitemapDirectory` lists entries from Fiverr's public sitemaps. Legacy mode names are accepted and mapped automatically.
enumTitles: Search gigs by keyword or category URL
Legacy alias: discover Logo Maker ideas
Legacy alias: discover gigs and fetch details
mode.title: Mode

onlineOnly.description: Keep only sellers who are online now (mode=search).
onlineOnly.title: Online sellers only

searchKeyword.description: Only keep sitemap entries whose URL or slug contains this keyword (mode=sitemapDirectory). Also filters gig titles in detail and search modes when set. Case-insensitive. Leave empty for no filtering.
searchKeyword.title: Keyword filter

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on Fiverr (mode=search), e.g. `logo design` or `voice over`. One search is run per query.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

searchUrls.description: Fiverr search or category URLs to browse (mode=search), e.g. `https://www.fiverr.com/search/gigs?query=logo%20design` or a `/categories/...` URL. Filters already in the URL are preserved.
searchUrls.title: Search or category URLs

sellerCountries.description: Keep only sellers living in these countries (mode=search), using ISO-2 codes such as `US`, `GB`, `DE`, `PK`, `IN`.
sellerCountries.title: Seller countries

sellerLanguages.description: Keep only sellers who speak these languages (mode=search), using ISO codes such as `en`, `es`, `de`, `fr`, `hi`, `ur`.
sellerLanguages.title: Seller languages

sellerLevels.description: Keep only these seller levels (mode=search). Values: `top_rated_seller`, `level_two_seller`, `level_one_seller`, `na` (new seller). Leave empty for all levels.
sellerLevels.title: Seller levels

sellerUrls.description: Fiverr seller usernames or profile URLs, e.g. `michael7878` or `https://www.fiverr.com/michael7878` (mode=sellerProfiles).
sellerUrls.title: Seller usernames or URLs

sitemapType.description: Which Fiverr sitemap directory to list (mode=sitemapDirectory).
sitemapType.title: Sitemap type

title: Fiverr Scraper Input
